verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents tracing of agent runs and inspecting threads and runs in Messages, Turns, and Details views. A threads query API (`POST /api/v2/threads/query`) supports thread grouping, and a hands-on user describes inspecting inputs and outputs for each step of a graph trace. However, no first-party evidence explicitly describes parent/child nested span hierarchies, and one community comment claims it only shows LLM inferences. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of nested span/run hierarchy for multi-step agents, explicit documentation of session grouping beyond threads, and corroboration resolving the conflicting community report about step-level visibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Inspect threads and runs in the Messages, Turns, and Details views.
Traces are the record of what your agents did in production.
The power of LangSmith is seeing full traces moving through the graph and being able to inspect the inputs and outputs for each step
Unify traces when calling your deployed Agent Server from another service using RemoteGraph or the SDK.
